# On and off by default — the `django` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#django).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** never — installing the pack is the opt-in.
- **Rules:** 7 — 0 on, 0 on with `preview = true`, 7 off in an opt-in preset, 0 in no preset.

## Presets

| `django/recommended` | no — opt in | 7 | 7 warn | the 7 flake8-django, through Ruff's `DJ` rules (Ruff 0.16.9) that Ruff calls stable, reimplemented (W-139) |
